phase: ROADMAP Stage 5 (final item): regression evaluation runner skeleton v1 (assemble/validate/summarize already-produced component reports; synthetic fixture only). Completes the Stage 5 deterministic skeletons.
summary: Added a deterministic, stdlib-only Stage 5 regression-evaluation runner skeleton. build_regression_evaluation_run normalizes a config (trigger_kind rules_update/model_update/manual, baseline_ref, candidate_ref, suite, and component reports) into a run record with normalized report counts and baseline/candidate metric pairs. validate_regression_evaluation_run checks required metadata, supported trigger kind, unique report names, known report kinds (warn), and well-formed numeric metric values. summarize_regression_evaluation_run aggregates pass/fail/warn totals, computes candidate-minus-baseline metric deltas, and returns a deterministic overall status (failed / needs_review / passed). A CLI tools/run_regression_evaluation.py assembles+validates+summarizes. It normalizes already-produced reports only; it does not execute evaluations, invoke a model, hit the network, or schedule CI.
implemented: backend/server.py: added build_regression_evaluation_run(config) with method=regression_evaluation_run_v1; normalized metadata + reports (name/kind/status/counts/metrics), metric values coerced to float baseline/candidate pairs (bare numeric -> candidate-only).

backend/server.py: added validate_regression_evaluation_run(run) returning {passed, errors, warnings, report_count, report_names}; enforces required metadata, supported trigger_kind, unique report names, numeric metric values; warns on unknown report kind, missing status/counts, or no reports.

backend/server.py: added summarize_regression_evaluation_run(run) with method=regression_evaluation_summary_v1; pass/fail/warn totals, per-report candidate-minus-baseline metric deltas, and overall status (failed if any report failed/failed>0; else needs_review if warnings/deltas/needs_review; else passed).
tools/run_regression_evaluation.py: CLI (--config/--json) delegating to the server helpers; exit 0/1/2.
tests/data/regression_run_sample.json: synthetic rules_update run with 3 component reports carrying baseline/candidate metric pairs.
tests/test_regression_evaluation.py: 17 tests across build, validation, summary, and the CLI.

risks: Overall status is a coarse deterministic rollup: any metric delta (in either direction) forces needs_review, so a purely improving candidate is still flagged for a human to look at rather than auto-passed.
The runner trusts caller-supplied component report statuses/counts; it does not re-run or cross-check the underlying evaluations, so a wrong input report yields a wrong summary.
Metric deltas are raw candidate-minus-baseline with no thresholds, regression-direction awareness (higher-is-better vs lower-is-better), or significance testing.
Fixtures are synthetic placeholder data; a green run here does not indicate real evaluation coverage.

Environment note: the local interpreter is python3 (no bare 'python' on PATH); the quality-gate runner honors PYTHON=python3, and a local 'python->python3' PATH shim lets its default-interpreter meta-test pass.
